title: Local generation crashes on 2.0: comfy-aimdo 'VRAM Allocation failed' -> CUDA unknown error (first public 2.0 bug)
description: First public 2.0 user report (2026-10-05). RTX 3060 12 GB, 64 GB RAM, driver 617.14 (CUDA 13.4), in-place upgrade 1.5.0 -> 2.0.0, engine matches 2.0 exactly (ComfyUI 0.34.0, comfy-aimdo 0.4.15, torch 2.13.0+cu130). klein-4b:t2i over MCP: text encode took 4m17s, sampler stuck at 'Model Initializing' 2m17s, then 'aimdo: src/model-vbar.c:403:ERROR:VRAM Allocation failed' -> vbar_fault 'Fault failed: 2' -> 'CUDA error: unknown error'; Chromium GPU process crashed the same second (exitCode=34); ComfyUI exited code=3. Upstream OPEN, not fixed through aimdo 0.5.5: Comfy-Org/comfy-aimdo#100 (cuMemSetAccess error 600 'device not ready', Windows, same aimdo/torch, also hit on Flux2 Klein on a 3090 and on Ada) and Comfy-Org/ComfyUI#12943. Intermittent; a retry often clears it; --disable-dynamic-vram removes it. Decision needed before code: how the local engine falls back (retry-once on 'Fault failed', restart engine with --disable-dynamic-vram after an aimdo fault, or a compatibility toggle). Note: our minVramGb floors may assume aimdo spill, so a blanket --disable-dynamic-vram changes what fits. Log: Fabio's Downloads/'app (1).log' (not committed, holds the user's Windows username).
